meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 pty 里无头驱动你的引擎应用,回放它的每一帧,录制整段验证视频,并生成含可点击时间线、检查表和截图的 summary 页面。
howto.when: 当你要验证引擎应用的界面行为、需要可回看的录屏和逐条 pass/fail 检查时,它会接管并写 driver 脚本。

say.text: 写个 driver 验证打字应用,录好视频并打开 summary
滚动后检查是否重绘,再存一张 after-scroll 截图
say.note: 检查结果会进 summary 的检查表

say.text: 用 pixel open 打开这次的 summary.html
say.note: 页面含视频、时间线、检查表和截图

howto.what_en: Claude drives your engine app headlessly in a pty, records a video of the whole run, writes pass/fail checks, and generates a summary page with a clickable timeline, checks table and stills.
howto.when_en: When you need to verify an engine app's UI behaviour with a recorded video and pass/fail checks, it takes over and writes the driver script.

say_en.text: Write a driver script for the typing app and record the run
Check that scrolling redrew, then pin an after-scroll still
say_en.note: Checks appear in the summary checks table

say_en.text: Open this run's summary.html with pixel open
say_en.note: Shows video, timeline, checks and stills
